title: Telemetry shape normalizer and heuristic validator
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a lightweight normalization and heuristic validation layer for incoming usage telemetry to reduce ingestion drops and enable safe soft-migrations of evolving event shapes. The service should perform non-destructive corrections (timestamp parsing, versioned field aliases, numeric coercion), tag ambiguous events for later human review, and expose a configurable fallback mode that lets non-critical fields be stored in an 'unvalidated_payload' blob instead of failing ingestion. Goals: 1) reduce schema-validation rejection rate for Console usage events by >=60% for known malformed patterns; 2) keep median ingest latency increase <3ms at p95; 3) produce auditable flags for events needing rerun/backfill.
acceptance_criteria: Normalization ruleset stored in a versioned config and hot-reloadable
Heuristic validators produce deterministic flags and do not mutate original payloads
Fallback mode configurable per-customer and per-route via existing routing metadata
End-to-end integration test against representative malformed traces with >60% reduction in rejects
Performance regression absent: p95 latency increase <3ms under synthetic load
updates: 2026-03-01: Spike completed. Identified common failure modes: iso8601 variants, boolean-as-string, and legacy 'user_id' int vs string.
2026-03-03: Prototype normalizer implemented as a lightweight middleware using fastjson and a rule engine (YAML-driven). Proof-run on 5k events shows 58% reduction in rejects for sampled patterns.
2026-03-05: Added non-destructive strategy: stores original payload in metadata, writes normalized copy to canonical_payload, and sets validation_flags list.
2026-03-07: Performance microbenchmark: single-threaded p95 latency cost +1.7ms; memory overhead acceptable. Need integration testing at 10k tps.
2026-03-09: Raised PR with spec and tests. Requesting review from telem team and product analytics for acceptable fallback semantics.
2026-03-10: Design review feedback received: add per-route opt-out, and surface misclassified event samples to the analytics console. Adjusting config schema to include 'sensitivity' parameter.

Run full integration load test at 10k tps and capture p50/p95/p99
Add audit view in Console to surface flagged events and allow replay/backfill
Coordinate with infra to enable gradual rollout and feature flagging per-customer
